facts.fact: CSIS describes Kenya's five-year AI Strategy (2025-2030) as in place, positioned within the digital economy master plan; no adoption date is given, so the document's published date 2026-07-22 is used.

CSIS states Kenya's AI Strategy is backed by a $1 billion (KES 152 billion) implementation budget, with much of it for connectivity, data centres and innovation hubs; no allocation date is given, so the published date 2026-07-22 is used.
